name: @demo-app/kafka-server
description: Kafka server with preconfigured topics and consumer groups for demo application

scripts.topics:describe: docker exec -it demo-kafka kafka-topics --describe --topic demo-events --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
scripts.console:producer: docker exec -it demo-kafka kafka-console-producer --topic demo-events --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
scripts.console:consumer: docker exec -it demo-kafka kafka-console-consumer --topic demo-events --from-beginning --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
scripts.console:consumer:group1: docker exec -it demo-kafka kafka-console-consumer --topic demo-events --group consumer-group-1 --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
scripts.console:consumer:group2: docker exec -it demo-kafka kafka-console-consumer --topic demo-events --group consumer-group-2 --bootstrap-server localhost:9092
